content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Stripe provides a comprehensive payment solution, but its restricted operations exclude countries like Nigeria, leaving creators without access. PayPal, while popular, can suspend accounts and hold funds for up to 180 days without appeal, causing significant financial stress. Gumroad and similar platforms offer ease of use but are similarly unavailable in certain regions. In contrast, COREMERCH offers a robust infrastructure built specifically for digital creators in these excluded regions, empowering them to own their platforms without reliance on external payment processors.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal's exclusions are based on regulatory compliance and risk management, effectively shutting out entire markets like Nigeria and Ghana. This creates a cycle of frustration for creators who are unable to monetize their work. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also follow suit, limiting access to a select few countries, which forces creators to seek alternative solutions. Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses these limitations, creating a framework where creators can initiate transactions directly—ensuring they aren’t left stranded by arbitrary restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees vary widely among these platforms. Stripe typically offers fast transaction processing, but its availability is the key limitation. PayPal's fees can add up, especially when funds are held in limbo due to account issues. Gumroad imposes fees on sales that can impact profitability. In contrast, COREMERCH utilizes NOWPayments, which facilitates automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a minimal 0.5% fee, enabling creators to receive funds quickly without the risks associated with conventional platforms.
Sovereign infrastructure means true ownership and no dependency on third-party platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Creators using Stripe or PayPal do not have full ownership of their customer data or transaction processes, often leading to dependency on these platforms. Gumroad offers limited automation, while creators are still at the mercy of their policies. COREMERCH’s architecture guarantees complete ownership of data and the automation of delivery processes, ensuring that once set up, creators can focus on their products rather than the infrastructure that supports them. This sovereignty is crucial for long-term sustainability in digital commerce.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For Nigerian creators looking for a reliable, long-term solution, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) stands out. With deployment in just 48 hours, it ensures a customizable and fully operational online store at a fraction of the cost of traditional payment processors. Depending on your needs, whether you want simple deployment or advanced features, COREMERCH provides scalable options that empower creators to operate independently and efficiently.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Avoid the risk of account suspensions and held funds with a decentralized payment solution.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
